{{Top|leg}}
A '''microsecond''' was a unit of [[Time/Legends|time]]. [[Droid/Legends|Droids]] could retrieve information from their permanent memories in microseconds, making them much faster at information retrieval than [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> [[Particle shield/Legends|Particle shields]] equipped on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] were raised and lowered with microsecond precision when launching carried craft like [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] or when physical projectiles like [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] were fired.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
